tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Only Public Sector Banks (Nationalized Banks)/ Regional Rural Banks are allowed to participate in the Tender process with the branch having at local Bagalkot city. Only banks incorporated in India are considered. Foreign banks are not considered.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any State Government/ Government of India / Union Territory

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
Bank conditions of lowering the interest rate in case pre closure of FD, may please be mentioned in the bid documents (in the format of information to be provided by the banks) as Annexure-II.
The University has sole discretion to decide the number of days of FDs to be kept

The bank who quotes highest interest rate would be considered for keeping deposits provided, it meets all other eligibility criteria. The University vests the discretion to decide the number of days of FDs to be kept.
The University has the sole authority to keep or not to keep deposits depending upon the requirement and interest of the university
Once interest rates are quoted that is binding and final. No subsequent reduced rates are considered what so ever reason it may be.
F.D., matured amount should be remitted to the UHS account on the last day of maturity. It should be in the form of D.D. or RTGS only.
No influence is allowed in the tender process.
If there is any delay in refunding the FD amount, the Bank is responsible for variation in interest amount and it should be made good at the cost of the Bank
The Right of postponing the date of process and finalizing is reserved with the University of Horticultural Sciences, Bagalkot.
If the date of opening of tender happens to be holiday / declared as holiday, tender will be opened on the next immediate working day.
In the event of any disputes, the decision of Honble Vice-Chancellor is final and binding on the agency (Banks).
The agencies shall visit website Corrigendum / addendum time to time if any.
University of Horticultural Sciences, Bagalkot exempted from TDS.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Profile of the Bank as per the format given (Annexure-III). Upload duly signed profile of the Bank as per the format given in the letter head of the Bank

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Enclose Profile of the Bank as per the format given (Annexure-III)

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Should have AAA credit rating or equal rating (Rating from CRISIL, ICRA as FITCH ratings shall only be considered). Upload AAA credit rating or equal rating certificate.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Enclose AAA credit rating or equal rating

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Networth : Banks should have a Net worth of Rs.5,000 crores in case of PSBs Rs. 1,000 Crores in case of RRBs. Upload self certified copy of the Balance Sheet and relevant Schedule (Audited) for FY 2023-24 or 2024-25 and a self certified copy of the net worth calculation in support of Net worth.

Capital Adequacy Ratio : Capital Adequacy Ratio of the investee bank shall not be less than 12% for PSBs and 8.32% for RRBs. Upload self certified copy of the Balance Sheet and relevant Schedule (Audited) for FY 2023-24 or 2024-25 and a self certified copy of CAR calculation in support of Capital Adequacy Ratio

Profitability Track Record : Profitability Track Record for PSBs shall have profitability track record of at least 2 years out of immediate 5 years and is also applicable to RRBs. Upload self certified copy of the Profit and loss account for FY 2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25.

Net NPA : Net NPA should be less than 1.00% for PSBs and 8.40% for RRBs.(As per GO order No. FD 52 TAR 2025 dated : 23.09.2025). Upload self certified copy of the Balance Sheet and relevant Schedule / Note (Audited) for FY 2023-24 or 2024-25 in support of Net NPA

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Bank should be a Public Sector Banks Nationalized Banks / Regional Rural Banks from the Union of India. Certificate shall be attached
Banks should have a Net worth of Rs. 5,000 crores in case of Public Sector Banks Nationalized Banks, Rs 1,000 Crores in case of Regional Rural Banks.
GST Registration Certificate. Certificate shall be registered.
GST RI for returned file for last 6 months Return file shall be attached. Latest for financial year 2025-26.
Net NPA should be less than 1.00 percentage for Public Sector Banks Nationalized Banks and 8.40 percentage for Regional Rural Banks.
PAN card details under the Income tax Act of the company. Enclose photo copy of the PAN Card.
Profitability Track Record during the preceding 5 consecutive years of at least 2 years 2 years both for Public Sector Banks Nationalized Banks and Regional Rural Banks.
Should have AAA credit rating or equivalent rating. Ratings from CRISIL, ICRA or FITCH rating shall only be considered.
Should have Capital Adequacy Ratio not less than 12 percentage for Public Sector Banks Nationalized Banks and not less than 8.32 percentage for Regional Rural Banks
The Bank shall attach the Profit declared quarterly for the year 2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 if possible. Relevant records shall be attached.
